scope: Bounded installed regression checks on the exact signed production bundle, plus isolated authenticated API checks; not exhaustive testing of every screen
environment: Existing isolated WM_Launch_API_36 emulator, emulator-5556, universal APK derived from the signed AAB
checks: English and Spanish home, access and directory screens, actual public screenshots and persisted language after relaunch
Full-color Google branding, both provider buttons, password compatibility, email-code and couple/vendor role choices
Google and Apple system-browser handoff and cancellation return on final build 12; the app rejects any non-S256 PKCE challenge before opening a provider
Existing vendor session survives the upgrade; inbox and avatar controls occupy the same header row
Private vendor workspace, separate pricing/contact sections, independent starting-price button, personal contact profile and sign-out
Isolated couple password login, first missing setup step, retained contact country and required phone validation
Wedding-style selector, calendar date selection, blank optional estimates and final review before any save
Inbox access, couple session restoration after cold relaunch, discarded unsaved planning draft and sign-out
assertionsRecoveredAcrossFlows: The guest run completed all EN/ES assertions and six captures, then its final home tap encountered an emulator transport interruption; later home/navigation checks passed
Vendor section and profile selectors were corrected after inspecting their visible positions
The couple fixture intentionally has incomplete planning details; the expected missing-step setup replaced an initial assumption that personal-profile editing would be available
The couple review save control was below the viewport; scrolling exposed it and the follow-up check passed without saving
limits: No physical Android device was used
Provider handoff/cancellation was tested; no real Google or Apple identity was signed in through the emulator
The couple planning save was deliberately not invoked; validation/save rules have application regression coverage
The public directory is empty; no fictional vendors, outfits, bookings or conversations were published for screenshots
App Store publication and the existing Apple release were not changed
